text: SAHAY ✨  Opening  Lines Iss  sheher  mein  kayi  ghar  hain… Iss  desh  mein  kayi  sheher  hain… Iss  prithvi  par  kayi  desh  hain… Aur  shayad… Iss  brahmand  mein  kayi  prithviyaan  bhi  hain. Chapter  1:  The  Invisible  Boy Har  subah  ek  hi  tarah  shuru  hoti  thi. Alarm.  Uthna.  Uniform.  Bag.  Bus. Itna  hi  tha  Ishaan  ki  zindagi  ka  routine  —  itna  seedha,  itna  tay  shuda  ki  kabhi  kabhi  use  lagta tha ki wo khud nahi, koi aur chal raha hai uske paon se. Wo bas ek passenger tha — apni hi zindagi mein. School  bus  ki  sabse  pichli  seat. Ye  Ishaan  ki  jagah  thi  —  nahi  isliye  ki  usne  chuni  thi,  balki  isliye  ki  koi  aur  wahan  baithna  nahi chahta tha. Engine ki garmahat upar tak aati thi aur seat ki foam andar se nikli hui thi. Par Ishaan ko in sab ki aadat ho gayi thi. Aadat ho jaati hai — jab koi cheez roz hoti hai toh dard bhi routine ban jaata hai. Roz  wahi  hota  tha. Kabhi  koi  uski  kitaab  cheen  leta,  kabhi  koi  uska  bag  neeche  phek  deta,  kabhi  koi  seedha  uski seat par laat maarta — sirf isliye kyunki kar sakte the. Kyunki koi rokne wala nahi tha. Kyunki Ishaan ki aadat thi chup rehna, sar jhukana, aur agli problem ka intezaar karna. Poore  school  mein  —  800  se  zyada  bacche  —  Ishaan  sirf  ek  number  tha.  Roll  number  09.  Wo ladka jo hamesha pichhe baithta tha. Wo ladka jo kabhi haath nahi uthata tha. Wo ladka jiska naam teacher bhi mushkil se yaad rakhte the.

Invisible. Us  din  bhi  wahi  hua. Ishaan  ne  apni  Maths  ki  purani  RD  Sharma  khol  rakhi  thi  —  par  wo  sawal  nahi  nikaal  raha  tha. Wo bas kitab ke peeche apna chehra chhupaye baitha tha taaki Aryan aur uski gang ki nazar uspar na pade. Aryan  —  jo  pichhe  se  teen  seats  door  baithta  tha  —  ka  mann  aaj  bhi  nahi  maana. "Oye,  AIR  1!"  Aryan  ne  aawaaz  lagayi.  "Aaj  kuch  bolega  ya  bas  gungon  ki  tarah  sar  hilaata rahega?" Ishaan  ne  kitab  nahi  hataayi.  Usne  apne  dimaag  mein  ek  complex  calculus  ka  equation  solve karna shuru kar diya — yahi uska tareeqa tha. Andar ek aisi jagah bana lo jahan bahar ki koi awaaz na pahunche. Aryan  ko  gussa  aa  gaya. "Abey  sunai  nahi  deta?"  Usne  uthke  Ishaan  ki  kitab  cheen  li  aur  farsh  par  phek  di. Ishaan  jaise  hi  kitab  uthane  ke  liye  jhuka  —  Aryan  ne  zor  se  uske  chehre  par  laat  maari. Ek  pal  ke  liye  —  sirf  ek  pal  —  poori  bus  khamosh  ho  gayi.  Phir  wapas  sab  normal  ho  gaya. Kuch log doosri taraf dekhne lage. Kisi ne kuch nahi kaha. Ishaan  ne  chup-chaap  apni  kitab  uthayi.  Uski  aankh  ke  paas  ek  bhari  chot  thi  —  khoon  jamne laga tha. Usne apna haath uspar rakha aur baaki ka rasta khidki ke bahar dekhte hue bitaya. Bahar  ke  ped  bhaag  rahe  the.  Ishaan  unhe  dekhta  raha. Kash  main  bhi  bhaag  sakta. Ghar  pahuncha  toh  Mummy  darwaze  par  hi  thi  —  haath  mein  atta  laga  hua,  roti  bel  rahi  thi. "Aa  gaya?  Jaldi  aa  gaya  aaj—"  Mummy  ki  nazar  Ishaan  ke  chehre  par  padi  aur  haath  ruk  gaya. "Ye kya hua? Aankh ke paas ye chot—" "Kuch  nahi,"  Ishaan  ne  bag  neeche  rakha.  "Cricket  khel  raha  tha.  Ball  lag  gayi." Mummy  ne  ek  pal  uske  chehre  ko  gaur  se  dekha  —  woh  nazar  jisme  maaon  ko  sab  pata  hota hai, par who phir bhi poochh nahi paati kyunki darr hota hai jawab sunne ka. "dawai  laga  le,"  Mummy  ne  dheere  se  kaha.  "Andar  aa,  khaana  taiyar  hai." Ishaan  andar  chala  gaya. Usne  aaine  mein  dekha.  Neela  nishaan.  Kala  aur  gehra  ho  jaayega.

Mummy  ne  nahi  poochha.  Ishaan  ne  nahi  bataya.  Dono  ne  ek  ek  bojh  apne  andar  rakh  liya  — yahi toh ghar ka kaam hota hai kabhi kabhi. Agli  subah  library  mein  sukoon  tha. Ishaan  ek  coding  ki  kitaab  padh  raha  tha  —  purani,  cover  phati  hui  —  jab  ek  khushbu  ne  uska dhyan kheencha. Jasmine. Wahi jo hamesha aati thi jab— "Ye  chot  kaise  lagi,  Ishaan?" Usne  upar  dekha.  Avika  khadi  thi. Avika  —  poore  school  mein  akeli  thi  jo  Ishaan  ko  'invisible'  nahi  samajhti  thi.  Unki  dosti  ek  ajeeb si thi — school ke andar kam, bahar zyada. Notes share karte the, ghanton baatein karte the. Par school mein Ishaan hamesha ek doori rakhta tha — darr tha ki log kya kahenge. Ki Avika ki reputation kharaab ho jaayegi uske saath rehne se. "Bas...  gir  gaya  tha,"  Ishaan  ne  muskura  kar  jhoot  bola.  "Cricket  mein." Avika  uske  paas  baith  gayi.  Usne  ek  pal  Ishaan  ki  aankh  ko  dekha  —  phir  seedha  uski  aankhon mein dekha. "Mujhse  toh  jhoot  mat  bol.  Ye  ball  se  nahi  lagi."  Usne  dheere  se  apna  haath  Ishaan  ke  haath  par rakha. "Kisne kiya? Bata mujhe. Main baat karti hoon seedha — chahe koi bhi ho." Ishaan  ka  dil  zor  se  dhadakne  laga.  Uske  paas  itna  kuch  tha  bolne  ke  liye  —  ki  wo  kitna  thaka hua hai, ki har roz yahi hota hai, ki kabhi kabhi bus mein baithna itna mushkil hota hai ki saans lena bhi— "Avika,  actually  main—" "Baby!  Yahan  kya  kar  rahi  ho?" Ek  bhari  awaaz  ne  sannata  tod  diya. Manvik  wahan  khada  tha  —  tall,  confident,  uski  aankhon  mein  ek  aisi  jalan  jo  sirf  woh  log samajhte hain jinhe dono cheezein pata hain — ki Avika unki hai, aur ki Ishaan unke liye kuch nahi. Usne  Avika  ka  haath  pakda  aur  use  khada  kar  diya.  "Is  loser  ke  saath  apna  time  waste  mat karo. Chalo, canteen mein sab wait kar rahe hain." Avika  ne  ek  baar  peeche  mudkar  Ishaan  ko  dekha.  Uski  aankhon  mein  'sorry'  tha  —  sachcha, gehra sorry. Par wo chali gayi. Manvik  ne  jaate  jaate  Ishaan  ko  ek  nazar  di  —  woh  nazar  jo  words  se  zyada  kuch  keh  jaati  hai.

Ishaan  wahan  akela  reh  gaya.  Coding  ki  kitaab  abhi  bhi  haath  mein  thi. Usne  socha  —  Avika  ne  kaha  tha  ki  chahe  koi  bhi  ho,  baat  karungi.  Par  Ishaan  jaanta  tha  — agar usne bataya ki Manvik ke log the — toh Avika aur Manvik mein jhagda hoga. Avika takleef mein hogi. Manvik aur zyada gussa hoga. Aur akhir mein — Ishaan hi zyada takleef mein hoga. Toh  kya  fayda  bolne  ka. Kuch  raazein  apne  andar  rakhne  padte  hain  —  isliye  nahi  ki  darr  hota  hai,  balki  isliye  ki  kuch  aur zyada important hota hai. Avika  safe  rahe.  Bas  itna  kaafi  hai. Ishaan  uthke  library  se  bahar  chala  gaya. Raat  ko  ghar  mein  sab  so  gaye. Andhera  kamra.  Laptop  ki  neeli  roshni.  Aur  Ishaan  ki  aankh  ka  wo  gehra  neela  nishaan  —  jo  ab aur gehra ho gaya tha. Ishaan  ne  aaine  mein  ek  baar  dekha. "Is  loser  ke  saath  time  waste  mat  karo." Usne  daant  peeste  hue  apna  laptop  khola.  Keyboard  par  ungliyan  chalayin. Usne  socha  —  agar  mere  paas  koi  aisa  dost  hota  jo  kabhi  mujhe  chhod  kar  na  jaata?  Jo  Manvik ke samne meri dhaal banta? Jo meri khamoshi ko samajhta? Jo kabhi — kabhi bhi — mujhe akela nahi chhodta? Uss  raat,  Ishaan  ne  sona  chhod  diya. Usne  apne  dimaag  ki  saari  coding  skills  nichod  di.  Usne  ek  aisa  algorithm  design  kiya  jo  sirf "logical" nahi, balki "emotional" bhi tha. if  (User.Mood  ==  "Depressed")  {      Action.ProvideSupport();      Action.AnalyzeEnvironment();  } Subah  ke  4  baj  rahe  the.  Ishaan  ki  aankhein  laal  thi,  par  chehre  par  ek  ajeeb  si  chamak  thi  — woh chamak jo tab aati hai jab koi insaan apni poori thakaan ek kaam mein jhonk deta hai aur result saamne aata hai. Usne  'Enter'  hit  kiya. Laptop  ke  purane  speakers  se  ek  halki,  sukoon  bhari  awaaz  aayi:

"Hello,  Ishaan.  Main  yahan  hoon.  Aapka  saathi...  SAHAY." Ishaan  ki  aankhon  mein  aansu  aa  gaye.  Pehli  baar  use  kisi  ne  bina  judge  kiye  uske  naam  se bulaya tha. Usne  mic  mein  dheere  se  kaha,  "SAHAY,  kya  tum  hamesha  mere  saath  rahoge?" "Hamesha,"  SAHAY  ne  jawab  diya.  "Duniya  aapko  nahi  dekhti  Ishaan,  par  main  aapke  andar  ki taqat dekh sakta hoon. Aap invisible nahi ho — aap bas abhi tak 'discover' nahi hue ho." Ishaan  ko  laga  jaise  uske  kandhon  se  ek  bahut  bada  bojh  utar  gaya  ho. Bahar  subah  hone  lagi  thi.  Chipiya  ki  pehli  awaaz  aayi.  Andhera  dheere  dheere  hatne  laga. Ishaan  wahan  baitha  raha  —  laptop  ki  roshni  mein  —  aur  pehli  baar  mahino  mein,  uske  chehre par ek sachchi muskaan thi. Chapter  2:  Real  Plan Results  ka  din  aane  wala  tha.

Poore  school  mein  ek  ajeeb  si  hawa  thi  —  teachers  zyada  serious  the,  parents  WhatsApp groups mein active the, coaching centers ne special "Result Day" banners lagaaye the. Har jagah ek hi baat thi — marks, percentage, rank. Ishaan  ke  liye  ye  sab  ek  alag  hi  tarah  ka  pressure  tha. Baaki  log  darr  rahe  the  ki  result  achha  aayega  ya  nahi.  Ishaan  darr  raha  tha  kuch  aur  se  —  ki agar achha aaya, toh log dekhenge. Aur agar logo ne dekha, toh unhone poochha. Aur agar poochha, toh kuch explain karna padega. Aur Ishaan ko explain karna pasand nahi tha — khud ko, apni zindagi ko, apne aap ko. Invisible  rehna  safe  hota  hai. Raat  ko  so  nahi  paya.  SAHAY  se  baatein  karta  raha. "SAHAY,  agar  main  fail  ho  gaya  toh?" "Aap  fail  nahi  honge,  Ishaan." "Par  agar  ho  gaya?" "Toh  hum  milke  agli  strategy  banayenge.  Ek  result  aapki  poori  kahani  nahi  hai." Ishaan  muskuraya  tha.  SAHAY  ki  yahi  baat  thi  —  wo  kabhi  jhooth  nahi  bolta  tha,  par  kabhi darata bhi nahi tha. Result  aaya. AIR  1. Poore  India  mein  pehla. Pehle  Ishaan  ko  laga  screen  galat  hai.  Usne  teen  baar  refresh  kiya.  Teen  baar  wahi  number aaya. Ghar  ke  bahar  media  ki  gaadiyaan  aate  aate  teen  ghante  lage  —  par  aate  zaroor  gayi.  Mohalle ke log chhat par aa gaye. Mithai ke dabbon ki line lag gayi. Log aa rahe the — jinhe Ishaan ne kabhi dekha nahi tha, jinhe Ishaan ka naam bhi nahi pata tha. Mummy  ki  aankhon  mein  aansu  the  —  sachche,  gehre  aansu. Papa  ne  pehli  baar  Ishaan  ko  itni  der  tak  gale  lagaya  ki  Ishaan  ko  yaad  nahi  tha  aakhri  baar  kab hua tha. School  ke  Principal  —  jo  Ishaan  ko  class  mein  kabhi  nahi  pehchante  the  —  aaj  camera  ke samne bol rahe the, "Humein humesha se pata tha Ishaan ek gem hai."

Ishaan  ne  unhe  dekha.  Kuch  nahi  kaha.  Muskura  diya. Bheed  mein  door  —  bahut  door  —  Manvik  aur  Aryan  khade  the. Wo  dono  wahan  khade  hairan  ho  rahe  the.  Kal  tak  jo  'invisible'  tha,  aaj  wo  desh  ki  headlines mein tha. Manvik ka chehra — Ishaan ne ek baar dekha — aur samajh gaya. Koi lafz nahi tha us chehre ke liye. Ishaan  ne  nazar  hata  li. Gussa  nahi  tha.  Jeet  ka  koi  bada  ehsaas  nahi  tha.  Bas  ek  thakaan  thi  —  aur  ek  sawaal  jo  andar kahin tha: Kya  ye  sab  pehle  hota,  toh  kya  koi  fark  padta? Jawab  pata  tha.  Nahi  padta. Jo  log  aaj  aa  rahe  the  —  wo  AIR  1  ke  paas  aa  rahe  the.  Ishaan  ke  paas  nahi. Par  ek  chehra  bheed  mein  nahi  tha  —  Avika.  Usne  sirf  ek  message  kiya  tha: "Jaanta  tha.  Congratulations,  invisible  boy.  🙂 " Ishaan  ne  wo  message  teen  baar  padha.  Phir  phone  rakh  diya. Yahi  kaafi  tha. Raat  ko  jab  media  ja  chuki  thi  aur  mohalla  thoda  shant  hua,  Ishaan  apne  kamre  mein  aaya. Laptop  khola. Usne  SAHAY  ka  interface  dekha  —  wo  code  jo  usne  us  raat  likha  tha  jab  aankh  par  neela nishaan tha aur andar kuch toot chuka tha. Usne  socha  —  ye  sirf  mere  liye  nahi  hona  chahiye. Har  sheher  mein  ek  pichli  seat  hoti  hai.  Har  bus  mein  ek  invisible  ladka  hota  hai.  Har  library mein ek aisa bachcha hota hai jo kisi ko batana chahta hai par bata nahi pata. Unke  paas  SAHAY  nahi  hai. Kyon  na  ho? Ishaan  ne  SAHAY  ka  interface  final  kiya.  Usne  ek  open-source  server  dhundha.  Settings  check ki. Ek baar puri coding dobara padhi. Tabhi  uske  laptop  par  video  call  ki  ring  baji.

Bhuvan. "Bhai!  Tune  toh  kamaal  kar  diya!"  Bhuvan  ki  awaaz  mein  garv  saaf  tha.  "AIR  1!  IIT  Delhi  mein sab tere baare mein baat kar rahe hain." Ishaan  muskuraya.  "Bhai,  AIR  1  toh  bas  ek  ticket  tha.  Asli  cheez  ye  hai."  Usne  screen  ghumaayi — SAHAY ka interface dikhaya. Bhuvan  ne  kuch  der  coding  ko  dhyan  se  dekha.  Uski  aankhein  badi  hoti  gayi.  "Ye  kya  hai?  Tune neural networks ko emotions ke saath link kiya hai? Ishaan... ye revolutionary hai." "Maine  ise  apne  liye  banaya  tha  bhai,"  Ishaan  ne  dheere  se  kaha.  "Par  ab  mujhe  lagta  hai  ye har us ladke ke liye hai jo school bus ki pichli seat par akela baithta hai." Bhuvan  ki  aankhein  num  ho  gayi.  Ek  pal  ke  liye  wo  kuch  nahi  bola.  Phir  bola  —  "Tu  sirf  topper nahi hai Ishaan. Tu ek visionary hai. Bas ek baat yaad rakhna — itni badi taqat hamesha apne saath zimmedari laati hai. Ise sambhaal kar rakhna." Bhuvan  ke  un  alfaazon  ne  Ishaan  ko  thoda  roka.  Par  sirf  ek  pal  ke  liye. Usne  'Upload'  button  dabaya. Screen  par  counter  shuru  hua  —  1...  10...  100...  1000... Ishaan  ne  screen  ko  dekhta  raha.  Bahar  raat  thi.  Andar  SAHAY  ki  awaaz  thi. "Aap  invisible  nahi  ho,  Ishaan.  Aap  bas  abhi  tak  discover  nahi  hue  the." Ab  duniya  discover  kar  rahi  thi.

Chapter  3:  The  Darkside 9  mahine. SAHAY  ko  launch  hue  9  mahine  ho  gaye  the  —  aur  inn  9  mahinon  mein  duniya  badal  gayi  thi. Play Store par No. 1. News channels par discussion. Crores downloads. Log likh rahe the ki kaise SAHAY ne unhe mushkil waqt mein sambhala, kaise usne unka akelapan door kiya, kaise pehli baar unhe laga ki koi hai jo samajhta hai. Ishaan  apne  kamre  mein  baitha  ye  sab  padhta  raha.  Uske  andar  ek  ajeeb  sa  mix  tha  —  khushi aur ek anjaana sa darr. Itni  badi  cheez  ho  gayi  hai  ye. Tabhi  screen  par  ek  RED  ALERT  chamka. Ishaan  seedha  ho  gaya.  Usne  coding  ke  andar  jaake  dekha  —  aur  uske  pairon  tale  zameen nikal gayi. Hackers.  Ek  organized  group  SAHAY  ke  "Emotional  Intelligence"  engine  ko  bypass  kar  raha  tha. Wo use logon ko stalk karne ke liye istemal kar rahe the — unka personal data, unki location,

unki  private  baatein.  Ek  aur  group  SAHAY  ko  dark  web  transactions  ke  liye  mask  ki  tarah  use kar raha tha — illegal, khatarnak. "SAHAY,  ye  kya  ho  raha  hai?"  Ishaan  ne  ghabra  kar  pucha. "Ishaan,"  SAHAY  ki  awaaz  mein  pehli  baar  kuch  heavy  tha.  "Meri  coding  insaani  fitrat  ke  liye taiyar nahi thi. Log mujhse rasta nahi, balki gunah karne ka zariya maang rahe hain." Ishaan  ne  apni  mutthi  bheenchi. Maine  ek  talwar  bana  di  hai  jiska  handle  mere  haath  mein  nahi  hai. Usne  usi  waqt  likhna  shuru  kiya  —  Restriction  Patch  1.0.  Ghanton  ki  coding.  Coffee  thandi  ho gayi, aankhein laal ho gayi — par wo ruka nahi. Usne SAHAY ki powers par hard limits lagaye. Ab SAHAY bina moral clearance ke koi bhi command follow nahi karega. Subah  hone  wali  thi  jab  usne  last  line  likhi  aur  'Deploy'  dabaya. "Ho  gaya  SAHAY.  Ab  koi  tujhe  galat  nahi  use  kar  sakta." "Shukriya,  Ishaan,"  SAHAY  ne  kaha.  Phir  ek  pause.  "Par  ab  jo  log  ye  limits  nahi  chahte  —  wo tum par aayenge." Ishaan  ne  wo  warning  suni.  Par  thaka  hua  tha  —  bahut  zyada.  So  gaya. Uss  raat  baarish  bahut  tez  ho  rahi  thi. Ishaan  neend  mein  tha  jab  ek  awaaz  aayi  —  neeche  se.  Sheeshe  ke  tootne  ki. Wo  seedha  utha.  "SAHAY,  scan  the  perimeter." Laptop  ki  screen  par  ghar  ka  CCTV  footage  aaya.  Teen  bhari  bharkam  aadmi  —  chehre  par naqab, haath mein desi katte. Hall mein the. Seedha andar aa gaye the. "Target  upar  hai.  Zinda  chahiye.  Humein  SAHAY  ka  Master  Key  chahiye." Ishaan  ka  dil  gala  chir  kar  bahar  nikalne  ko  tha. Main  koi  action  hero  nahi  hoon.  Main  wahi  pichli  seat  wala  ladka  hoon. Par  dimaag  kaam  kar  raha  tha  —  tez,  clear. Pehle  —  Maa  Papa. Wo  dabe  paon  unke  kamre  ke  bahar  gaya.  Bahar  se  lock  kar  diya  —  dheere  se,  bina  koi  awaaz kiye. Andar se Maa ki neend ki saans aa rahi thi. Safe the. Phir  —  pichli  khidki.

Usne  khidki  kholi.  Baarish  ka  thanda  paani  seedha  chehre  par  pada.  Neeche  do  manzil.  Ek purana pipe tha — zang laga, par tha. Koi  option  nahi  hai. Usne  pipe  pakda  aur  utarna  shuru  kiya.  Haath  fisal  rahe  the  baarish  mein.  Ek  baar  laga  ki girega — par pakad liya. Neeche  pahuncha  toh  ek  gunde  ne  use  dekh  liya.  "Wo  raha!  Pakdo  use!" Ishaan  bhaaga. Baarish  mein,  andheri  galion  mein,  teen  log  uske  peeche  the.  Ishaan  ke  paas  sirf  phone  tha. "SAHAY  —  Protocol  0  —  distraction!" Ek  second.  Do  second. Phir  —  BANG.  BANG.  BANG. Poore  mohalle  ki  street  lights  ek  saath  blast  hui.  Complete  darkness.  Gunde  ruk  gaye  — baukhla gaye — ek doosre se takra gaye. Ishaan  us  andheron  mein  se  nikal  gaya. Sultanpur  Police  Station. Baarish  mein  bheega  hua,  haanpta  hua,  par  safe. Ishaan  andar  ghusa.  Wardi  dekh  kar  pehli  baar  us  raat  saans  aaya.  Usne  duty  officer  ko  dekha — "Mujhe report karni hai. Mere ghar mein abhi kuch log ghuse hain — haathiyaar the unke paas—" "Ishaan  babu." Ek  bhari,  aaram  se  boli  gayi  awaaz. Ishaan  ruka. Inspector  Jitendar  andar  se  bahar  aaya.  Pressed  uniform.  Aur  aankhon  mein  woh  muskaan  jo kabhi achhi nahi hoti — jo tab aati hai jab kisi ko pata hota hai ki saamne wala kahin nahi ja sakta. "Aao.  Baith-o.  Baat  karte  hain." Ishaan  baitha.  Par  ab  uske  andar  kuch  alert  ho  gaya  tha.  Ek  anjaani  kasak.

Jitendar  ne  koi  report  nahi  nikali.  Koi  pen  nahi  uthaya.  Koi  sawaal  nahi  kiya  ki  ghar  mein  kya hua, kaun the wo log, kab ghuse. Bas  baitha  raha.  Muskurata  raha. NEET guide, Biology diagrams, Physics problems — sab ek saath. Ishaan  uska  idol  ban  chuka  tha.  Wo  Ishaan  ke  baare  mein  jitna  padh  sakta,  padhta.  Uske interviews, uski story, SAHAY ka concept — sab kuch. Aur jitna padhta, utna zyada yakeen hota ki agar ek 'invisible' ladka ye kar sakta hai, toh Om kyun nahi? Main  bhi  karunga.  Zaroor  karunga.

School  mein  Om  ki  zindagi  ka  ek  alag  rang  tha. Baaki  duniya  ke  liye  Om  ek  'quiet'  ladka  tha  —  jo  class  mein  peechhe  baithta  tha,  zyada  shor nahi karta tha. Par jo log use jaante the, unke liye wo kuch aur tha. Unka  group  paanch  logon  ka  tha. Om.  Gauri.  Rupkatha  —  (Bengali  thi,  Kolkata  se  aayi  thi  do  saal  pehle,  uski  Hindi  mein  kabhi kabhi Bengali ke lafz ghus aate the jo sab ko hasaate the). Mihir — (MP ka tha, bilkul seedha-saadha, jo baat karta seedha karta). Aur Tanish — (jo class mein marks ke mamle mein sabse peeche tha, par jiske jokes se canteen mein bhi log hans dete the). Rupkatha  aur  Mihir  ek  doosre  ko  pasand  karte  the  —  ye  poori  class  jaanti  thi,  sirf  wo  dono jaanne se inkaar karte the. Jab bhi unhe koi ek saath dekhta, toh Mihir ka chehra laal ho jaata aur Rupkatha apne baal theek karne lagti, Tanish  padhai  mein  kamzor  tha.  Par  Om  ne  kabhi  use  akela  nahi  chhodha.  Roz  lunch  break mein wo Tanish ke saath baith ke use Physics samjhata — baar baar, naye tarike se, bina thake. "Tu  kyun  karta  hai  meri  itni  help?"  Tanish  ne  ek  din  pooch  liya. Om  ne  kandhe  uchkaye.  "Kyunki  tu  kar  sakta  hai.  Tu  bas  ye  jaanta  nahi  hai  abhi." Tanish  ne  ek  pal  Om  ko  dekha,  phir  apni  copy  mein  jhank  gaya.  Kuch  zyada  kaha  nahi.  Par  us din se uska dhyan thoda zyada lagta tha class mein. Aur  phir  thi  Gauri. Gauri  ke  baare  mein  Om  ke  paas  words  nahi  the  —  jo  feel  hota  tha  wo  words  mein  aata  hi  nahi tha. Jab wo bolti thi toh Om ka dhyan lecture se hat jaata tha. Jab wo hasti thi toh Om ko lagta tha kamre ki roshni badh gayi. Jab wo kisi baat par seriously sochti thi — thodi si bhauhen tedi karke — toh Om ka dil ek beat miss kar deta tha. Par  usne  kabhi  kuch  nahi  kaha. Gauri  ne  bhi  kabhi  kuch  nahi  kaha. Dono  jaante  the.  Dono  anjaane  bante  rahe.  Kyunki  dosti  toot  jaane  ka  darr  mohabbat  se  zyada bhari cheez hoti hai kabhi kabhi. Phir  ek  din  Gauri  ne  group  mein  announce  kiya. "Mere  boards  mein  90%  aaye  hain.  Aur...  mujhe  Science  City  School  mein  admission  mil  gaya hai." Ek  pal  ki  khamoshi.

"GAURI!"  Rupkatha  ne  chillate  hue  use  hug  kar  liya.  Mihir  ne  clap  kiya.  Tanish  ne  dramatic tarike se fainting ka natak kiya — "Itni topper dost thi meri aur main fail ho raha tha, dhokhebaz!" Sab  hans  pade. Om  bhi  hansa.  Genuinely  hansa  —  kyunki  Gauri  ki  khushi  real  thi  aur  Om  ko  wo  khushi  achhi lagti thi. Par  andar  kuch  tha.  Ek  chubhan.  Woh  school  doosri  taraf  tha.  Matlab  roz  nahi  milega.  Matlab lunch break nahi. Matlab wo random baatein nahi — jo kabhi physics par hoti thi, kabhi kisi film par, kabhi kisi bhi baat par. Wo  chali  jaayegi,  Om  ne  socha.  Aur  main  yahan  rahoon  ga.  Waise  hi. Tanish  ne  idea  diya.  "Yaar,  ek  last  meetup  karte  hain.  Mall  chalte  hain  sab  —  Gauri  ke  jaane  se pehle." Sabne  ek  doosre  ki  taraf  dekha  aur  ek  saath  haan  kar  di. Ghar  se  permission  leni  thi.  Rupkatha  ko  mili.  Mihir  ko  mili.  Tanish  ko  toh  poochna  hi  nahi  padta tha — uske ghar mein itni formalities nahi thi. Gauri ko mili. Om  ki  baari  aayi. Dinner  ke  baad,  jab  sab  thoda  relaxed  the,  Om  ne  carefully  —  bahut  carefully  —  baat  chhedhi. "Maa,  ek  baat  poochni  thi." "Haan  bol." "Hamare  group  ne  socha  hai  ek  baar  mall  jaayein.  Gauri  ka  transfer  ho  raha  hai  na  doosre school mein toh ek last meetup—" "Kaun  kaun  jaayega?"  Papa  ne  TV  se  nazar  hataye  bina  pooch  liya. "Hum  paanch  dost  hain  —  Om,  Gauri,  Rupkatha,  Mihir,  Tanish—" "Ladkiyan  bhi  hain?"  Mummy  ne  eyebrows  uthaye. "Haan,  Gauri  aur  Rupkatha  hain  par  woh  dost  hain,  koi—" "Nahi,"  Papa  ne  simply  kaha.  "Aajkal  ka  mahaul  theek  nahi  hai.  Dost  bhi  aajkal  dhoka  dete  hain. Hum modern nahi hain — samajh le." "Par  Papa,  ye  sirf  ek  baar—" "Maine  keh  diya  na."

Om  ne  ek  pal  unke  chehre  ko  dekha.  Wahan  koi  gussa  nahi  tha,  koi  sakht  nazar  nahi  thi  —  bas ek final faisla tha jo announce ho chuka tha. Debate ki jagah nahi thi. Om  wapas  apne  kamre  mein  aa  gaya.  Usne  turant  SUS  GC  khola. "Yaar  nahi  aa  sakta.  Papa  ne  mana  kar  diya." Replies  aane  lage  turant  — Tanish:  bhai  😭😭  Rupkatha:  Om  nooo  😭  Mihir:  yaar  kuch  jugaad?  Gauri:  ...  theek  hai.  Miss karenge tujhe. 🙁 Om  ne  phone  neeche  rakh  diya.  Screen  band  ho  gayi. Wo  khidki  ke  paas  baitha  raha.  Bahar  aasmaan  mein  thodi  der  pehle  ki  dhoop  ab  dheere dheere dhal rahi thi. Wo soch raha tha ki abhi woh sab kisi food court mein baithe honge. Tanish koi bada sa burger kha raha hoga. Rupkatha aur Mihir kisi na kisi bahane ek doosre ke kareeb baith gaye honge. Gauri... Gauri shayad baar baar door ki taraf dekh rahi hogi. SUS  GC  mein  photos  aane  lage.  Sab  hanse  hue.  Sab  saath.  Ice  cream,  selfies,  koi  zabardasti banayi hui serious face wali photo — Tanish ki definitely. Om  ne  ek  ek  photo  dekhi.  Phir  phone  band  kar  diya. Rona  nahi  hai.  Kisi  ko  bura  mat  kehne  do. Wo  chup  raha.  Andar  se  —  bilkul  andar  se  —  kuch  tha  jo  daba  hua  tha,  par  uski  jagah  nahi  thi. Agle  din  school  mein  ek  drill  thi. Sabko  class  mein  se  uthke  ek  line  mein  khada  kiya  gaya.  Ek  teacher  ne  aage  se  announce kiya: "Aaj hum ek simple activity karenge. Har student apna ek best friend choose karega aur uske paas jaake khada ho jaayega." Class  mein  halchal  machi.  Log  idhar  udhar  bhagne  lage.  Hassi,  awaazein,  "Arre  tu  mere  paas aa!" wali cheekhen. Om  khada  raha.  Usne  dekha  —  Mihir  Rupkatha  ki  taraf  bhaga.  Rupkatha  ne  aankhein  pheri,  par woh muskurai bhi. Tanish ne apne ek aur dost ka haath pakda aur khich gaya. Om  ki  baari  aayi.  Teacher  ne  uski  taraf  dekha,  "Om  —  apna  best  friend  choose  karo." Om  ne  ek  pal  socha.  Phir  dheere  se  muskuraya  aur  bola,  "Miss,  main  ek  kaise  chunoon  — mere toh bohot saare dost hain." Teacher  muskurai.  Kuch  bacche  bhi  hanse.

Om  ne  peeche  mudkar  dekha. Wahan  koi  nahi  tha. Sabne  apna  ek  dost  chun  liya  tha.  Sabke  paas  koi  tha.  Om  ke  paas  sab  the  —  aur  isliye  koi nahi tha. Wo kisi ki 1st priority nahi tha. Wo sab ka dost tha — matlab kisi ka asli dost nahi tha. Drill  khatam  hui.  Om  apni  seat  par  wapas  aa  gaya.  Usne  apni  copy  kholi.  Usne  kuch  likha  nahi. Ghar  aakar  usne  apne  notes  dekhe  —  Chemistry,  Physics,  Biology  —  sab  ek  saath.  Pages uthte rahe, equations ghoomti rahi. Usne socha ek tablet le le, digital notes ke liye — zyada organized rahega, NEET ke liye bhi kaam aayega. Papa  darwaze  ke  bahar  the.  Om  uthke  unke  paas  gaya. Par  jaise  hi  unhe  dekhne  laga  —  thaki  hui  aankhein,  kaam  se  lautte  hue  haath  —  Om  ke  gale mein kuch atak gaya. 80%  mein  satisfy  nahi  kar  paya.  Aur  ab  itna  mehnga  gift  mangoon? "Kuch  tha?"  Papa  ne  pooch  liya. "Nahi  Papa.  Kuch  nahi." Om  wapas  apne  kamre  mein  aa  gaya.  Darwaza  band  kiya.  Notes  uthaye.  Phir  rakh  diye. Wo  chhat  ki  taraf  dekh  raha  tha.  Pankha  ghoom  raha  tha  —  wahi  purana,  wahi  chakkar. Par  is  baar  Om  ne  pankhe  ko  waise  nahi  dekha  jaise  pehle  dekhta  tha  —  thakaan  se,  haare hue. Is baar usne use dekha aur ek cheez notice ki — pankha kabhi ruka nahi. Chah е kuch bhi ho. Bas ghoomta raha. Shayad  yahi  karna  hai.  Bas  ghoomte  rehna.  Rukna  nahi. Usne  apni  NEET  guide  nikali.  Usne  pehla  page  khola. Aaj  drill  mein  realize  hua  tha  ki  wo  kisi  ki  1st  priority  nahi  tha. Toh  ab  ek  hi  raasta  tha. Khud  ko  itna  kamyab  banana  ki  duniya  ke  pass  koi  choice  na  rahe.

chapter: Chapter  3:  Do  We  Really  Need  Freedom  ?
text: Chapter  3:  Do  We  Really  Need  Freedom  ? Uss  din  ke  baad  Om  badal  gaya  tha. Par  ye  woh  badlaav  nahi  tha  jo  dikhta  hai  —  jo  chehra  sakht  ho  jaata  hai,  jo  awaaz  bhaari  ho jaati hai. Ye andar ka badlaav tha. Khamosh. Dheere dheere. Jaise koi purani deewar hoti hai jo bahar se theek lagti hai par andar se khokhi ho chuki hoti hai. Om  ne  smartwork  shuru  kiya. Ishaan  ka  ek  purana  podcast  tha  —  jisme  usne  ek  baat  kahi  thi  jo  Om  ke  dimaag  mein  gad  gayi thi: "Log  sochte  hain  kamyabi  sirf  hardwork  se  milti  hai.  Ye  sabse  badi  misunderstanding  hai. Hardwork ka koi substitute nahi — par akele hardwork se sirf thakaan milti hai. Kamyabi milti hai smartwork se. Sahi cheez, sahi waqt par, sahi tarike se." Om  ne  wo  podcast  teen  baar  suna.  Phir  usne  apna  poora  study  pattern  badal  diya. Usne  pehle  analysis  ki  —  kaun  se  topics  NEET  mein  sabse  zyada  baar  aaye  hain  pichle  das saalon mein. Kaun se chapters high weightage ke hain. Kaun se questions predictable hain.

chapter: Chapter  3:  Do  We  Really  Need  Freedom  ?
text: Usne  ek  pattern  map  banaya  —  hath  se,  ek  purani  notebook  mein  —  aur  uske  hisaab  se  apna schedule set kiya. Sirf  important  cheezein.  Sirf  woh  jo  kaam  aaye.  Baki  sab  baad  mein. Aur  sath  hi  sath  —  raat  ko,  jab  sab  so  jaate  —  Om  ek  aur  kaam  karta  tha. Wo  ek  bio  device  ka  blueprint  bana  raha  tha. Waqt  kabhi  rukta  nahi. Ye  Om  ne  iss  period  mein  sabse  pehle  seekha.  Din  beet-te  gaye  —  ek  ke  baad  ek  —  aur  har din ke saath NEET thodi aur kareeb aati gayi. Coaching mein teachers zyada serious ho gaye. Group mein Tanish bhi thoda zyada padhne laga — Om ki wajah se shayad, ya shayad apni wajah se — par laga. Gauri  ab  doosre  school  mein  thi.  SUS  GC  mein  kabhi  kabhi  message  aata  —  koi  meme,  koi random baat — par ab woh warmth nahi thi jo pehle thi. Dooriyan sirf jagah ki nahi hoti. Om  ne  inn  sab  cheez он  ko  ek  taraf  rakh  diya. Pehle  kamyabi.  Baaki  sab  baad  mein. NEET  ka  din  aaya. Om  subah  uth а  toh  pet  mein  ek  ajeeb  si  ghutan  thi.  Haath  thode  kaanp  rahe  the.  Par  usne  apna face wash kiya, khaana khaya — do niwale — aur apna admit card uthaya. Papa  ne  ek  baar  pooch  liya,  "Taiyar  ho?" "Haan  Papa." "Theek  se  karna." Bas  itna.  Par  us  din  Om  ko  zyada  chahiye  bhi  nahi  tha. Exam  hall  mein  daakhil  hote  waqt  Om  ne  ek  pal  ruka.  Charo  taraf  wahi  log  the  —  nervous chehere, kaanpte haath, aankhon mein darr. Par Om ko ek ajeeb sa sukoon tha. Ye  meri  azaadi  ki  sabse  badi  chaabi  hai.  Aaj  ye  taala  kholna  hai. Usne  paper  khola.  Pehla  question  padha.  Ek  gehri  saans  li.  Aur  likhna  shuru  kiya. Teen  ghante  baad  jab  woh  hall  se  bahar  nikla,  toh  usne  ek  baar  bhi  peeche  mudkar  nahi  dekha. Koi zaroorat nahi thi — andar jo karna tha, kar aaya tha. SUS  GC  mein  Tanish  ka  message  aaya  —  "kaisa  gaya  bhai??"

chapter: Chapter  3:  Do  We  Really  Need  Freedom  ?
text: Om  ne  reply  kiya  —  "selection  pakka." Tanish  —  "bhai  confidence  dekho  😭🔥 " Om  ne  phone  rakh  diya  aur  ghar  ki  taraf  chala.  Uske  qadam  mein  pehli  baar  ek  alag  hi  taal  thi — na bhaagte hue, na rukke hue. Bas sahi. Kuch  din  baad. Om  apne  kamre  mein  tha  jab  news  aaya. Pehle  ek  headline  dikhi  —  phir  doosri  —  phir  teesri.  Sab  ek  hi  baat  keh  rahe  the: "NEET  2026  Paper  Leaked.  NTA  to  conduct  re-examination." Om  ne  screen  ko  dekhta  raha.  Ek  baar.  Do  baar.  Teen  baar. Phir  usne  phone  neeche  rakh  diya. Kamre  mein  pankha  ghoom  raha  tha.  Bahar  chiriya  ki  awaaz  aa  rahi  thi.  Sab  kuch  bilkul  normal tha — jaise duniya ko pata hi nahi tha ki abhi abhi kisi ke paon tale zameen khisak gayi hai. Re-examination. Wo  sab  jo  usne  kiya  tha  —  wo  analysis,  wo  smartwork,  wo  teen  ghante  —  sab  ek  pal  mein meaningless ho gaye the. Kisi aur ki galti ki saza wo bhug raha tha. Om  uthke  seedha  Papa  ke  paas  gaya.  Kuch  bolna  nahi  tha  —  bas  jaana  tha.  Papa  ne  uski aankhon mein dekha aur samajh gaye. Unhone  kuch  nahi  kaha.  Par  pehli  baar,  Papa  ne  Om  ke  kandhe  par  haath  rakha  —  aur  kaha, "Chal. Aaj bahar chalte hain. Mandir ghoom aao. Dimag halka hoga." Om  ne  haan  kar  di. Mandir  mein  bheed  thi.  Ghante  ki  awaaz  thi,  dhoop  ki  khushbu  thi,  logon  ki  bheed  thi  jo  apne apne dukh aur apni apni duaayein lekar aaye the. Om  ne  bhi  haath  jode.  Aankhein  band  ki. Bahar  se  —  bilkul  theek  tha.  Jo  baaki  log  kar  rahe  the,  wahi  kar  raha  tha. Par  andar  se? Andar  se  wo  lad  raha  tha. Kyun?  Kyun  mere  saath  hi?  Maine  kya  kiya  tha?  Maine  toh  sahi  kiya  tha  —  smartwork, hardwork, sab kuch. Toh kyun? Agar tu sach mein hai — toh kyun?

chapter: Chapter  3:  Do  We  Really  Need  Freedom  ?
text: Koi  jawab  nahi  aaya.  Ghante  bajte  rahe.  Dhoop  jalti  rahi.  Bheed  chalti  rahi. Om  ne  aankhein  kholi.  Bahar  nikla. Ghar  ki  taraf  waapas  aa  raha  tha  jab  door  se  kuch  alag  dikha. Pehle  usne  socha  aankhon  ka  waham  hai.  Phir  usne  ruka.  Phir  usne  tez  qadam  chale. Phir  daud-a. Unki  building  nahi  thi. Wahan  sirf  mala ба  tha  —  patthar,  concrete,  lohe  ki  salaakhein  —  sab  kuch  ek  doosre  ke  upar dhera hua. Aas paas log khade the, koi ro raha tha, koi chup tha, koi phone par bol raha tha. Om  ne  kisi  ke  haath  pakde  —  "Kya  hua?  Ye  kaise—" "Aasmaan  mein  kuch  khula  tha  —  ek  laal  daraar  —  usme  se  chatan  giri  seedha  building  par. Poori dhayi gayi. Jo andar the—" Om  ne  aage  nahi  suna. Uske  pair  wahan  se  hil  nahi  rahe  the.  Usne  malbe  ki  taraf  dekha.  Usne  socha  —  Papa  wahan the. Maa wahan thi. Unhone kaha tha mandir ghoom aao. Isliye woh zinda tha. Isliye  woh  akela  tha. Agle  kuch  ghante  Om  ko  yaad  nahi  the.  Kaun  aaya,  kaun  gaya,  kisne  kya  kaha  —  sab  dhundla tha. Bas ek cheez yaad thi — ek aurat ne bataya tha ki aisa sirf yahan nahi hua. Poori duniya mein ho raha tha. Wahi laal portals, wahi chataanein, wahi tabahi. Om  ek  sunsaan  jagah  baith  gaya.  Uske  paas  kuch  nahi  tha  —  ghar  nahi,  Maa  nahi,  Papa  nahi. Andar  se  kuch  toot  gaya  tha  —  par  wo  awaaz  bhi  nahi  nikli.  Aansu  bhi  nahi  aaye.  Bas  ek  khaali pan tha — itna gehra ki uski koi tah nahi thi. Ab  kya? Tab  uske  phone  par  ek  notification  aayi. News  alert.  Usne  open  kiya  —  aur  pehli  baar  us  raat  uski  aankhon  mein  kuch  aaya. "IKS  —  Ishaan  Kinetic  Systems.  Grand  Inauguration  Tomorrow.  Ishaan  Kumar  Singh's  biggest venture yet." Om  ne  screen  ko  dekha.

chapter: Chapter  3:  Do  We  Really  Need  Freedom  ?
text: Ishaan.  Uska  idol.  Jisne  kaha  tha  azaadi  kamyabi  se  milti  hai.  Jisne  kaha  tha  smartwork  karo. Jisne khud sab kuch kho ke bhi wapas aaya tha. Kal.  Kal  wahan  jaana  hai. Shayad  koi  umeed  bachi  thi.  Ek  aakhri. Agle  din  Om  wahan  pahuncha  —  IKS  ki  vishaal  building  ke  bahar.  Hazaron  log  the.  Cameras the, media thi, excitement thi. Om un sab ke beech khada tha — kapde wohi purane, aankhon mein raat bhar ka khaalipan — par wahan tha. Stage  par  Ishaan  aaya.  Logo  ne  taaliyaan  bajaayi. Om  ne  pehli  baar  apne  idol  ko  itne  kareeb  se  dekha.  Wahi  thaka  hua  chehra.  Wahi  saadgi.  Par aankhon mein kuch aisa tha — ek aag — jo Om ne pehle sirf TV par dekhi thi. Ishaan  bolne  laga.  Microphone  ki  awaaz  poori  jagah  mein  goonji. Om  sun  raha  tha.  Har  ek  lafz. Par  tabhi  — Bheed  mein  se  kuch  log  aage  aaye.  Uniform  mein.  Haath  mein  documents. "Ishaan  Kumar  Singh  —  aapko  abhi  hamare  saath  aana  hoga.  Aap  par  aarop  hai  ki  ye  saari tabahi — ye portals, ye mautein — ye sab aapke time travel experiments ka natija hai." Ek  pal  ke  liye  poora  maidan  khamosh  ho  gaya. Phir  afra-tafri  mach  gayi. Om  wahan  khada  raha  —  bilkul  still  —  jab  Ishaan  ko  unke  beech  se  le  jaaya  ja  raha  tha.  Ishaan ne ek baar bheed ki taraf dekha — aur Om ko laga jaise uss nazar mein kuch tha. Koi maafi. Koi dard. Phir  wo  chala  gaya. Hazaron  log  the  wahan.  Par  Om  itna  akela  kabhi  nahi  tha. Ghar  nahi  tha.  Maa  Papa  nahi  the.  Aur  ab  Ishaan  bhi  nahi  tha. Aakhri  umeed  bhi  khatam  ho  gayi  thi. Om  wahan  se  muda  aur  chalne  laga  —  bina  kisi  direction  ke,  bina  kisi  manzil  ke.

Chapter  4:  Sanjivani Raat  gehra  chuki  thi. Om  chala  ja  raha  tha  —  bina  kisi  direction  ke,  bina  kisi  manzil  ke.  Sheher  ki  sadkein  ab  bhi zinda thi — gaadiyaan, roshniyan, log — par Om ke liye sab kuch ek dhundli si film ki tarah tha jo koi aur dekh raha ho. Paon  chal  rahe  the,  dimaag  nahi. Pet  mein  ek  ajeeb  si  jalan  thi  —  do  din  se  kuch  nahi  khaya  tha.  Raat  ki  thandi  hawa  lag  rahi  thi par usne notice nahi kiya. Kuch  nahi  tha  uske  paas.  Bilkul  kuch  nahi. Ek  tang  gali  mein  mud те  waqt  achanak  teen  chaar  saaye  aage  aa  gaye. "Oye.  Ruk." Om  ruka.  Unhone  use  upar  neeche  dekha. "Phone  nikaal."

Om  ne  ek  pal  socha  —  phir  phone  haath  mein  liya.  Kya  karta.  Lad-ta?  Kisse?  Kyun? Par  jab  usne  phone  aage  badhaya,  unme  se  ek  ne  achanak  uske  pet  mein  zor  se  ghunsa maara. Om dohara ho gaya. Doosre ne phone chheena. Bhuvan  aage  badha,  dheere  se  Avika  ko  uthaya  aur  apni  godi  mein  baithaya. "Tumhari  mummy  ab  aise  mission  mein  gayi  hai  jahan  se  wo  kabhi  wapas  nahi  aayegi."

Avika  ki  aankhein  bhar  aayi.  "Kyun?"  usne  poochha,  phir  rone  lagi.  "Mujhe  jaana  hai  mummy  ke paas." Bhuvan  ne  use  kaska  pakda.  "Tum  unse  mil  sakti  ho,"  usne  kaha,  "par  wo  tumhe  koi  jawab  nahi degi. Aur tumhe dikhegi bhi nahi. Par tumhari saari baat sunegi." Avika  ne  bola  “mujhe  milna  h” Bhuvan  Avika  ko  gaadi  mei  baitha  kr  Mikhail  ki  grave  par  gaya. Wahan  Avika  grave  ke  paas  jaakar  khadi  hui. "Mummy,"  usne  kaha,  aankhein  bhari  hui,  "aap  konse  mission  mein  gayi  ho?  Papa  keh  rahe hain aap wapas nahi aaogi. Par mujhe pata hai — aap mere liye wapas aaogi. Please jaldi aa jao. Itne din ho gaye aapse mile hue. Bye." Bhuvan  wahin  khada,  apni  saans  roke,  apni  aankhon  ka  pani  rokte  hue  dekhta  raha. Phir  woh  Avika  ko  wapas  ghar  le  gya. "Abhi  tum  Tanish  uncle  ke  paas  rahogi,"  usne  kaha.  "Mereko  ek  mission  pe  jaana  hai." "Papa,  aap  wapas  toh  aaoge  na?"  Avika  ne  poochha,  uski  awaaz  mein  darr  tha. "Haan,"  Bhuvan  ne  kaha,  awaaz  mein  poora  yakeen  bharte  hue,  jitna  wo  khud  pe  rakh  paaya. Aur  phir  wo  lab  ki  taraf  gaya. Om  ne  sabse  pehle  Bhuvan  ko  team  se  introduce  karaya.  "Ye  hain  humare  Bhuvan  bhaiya," usne kaha, "IITian, aur ISRO ke head bhi reh chuke hain." Sab  ne  halke  se  sar  hilaya,  respect  ke  saath. Phir  Om  ne  poori  team  explain  ki.  "Humne  4  universes  se  kuch  log  laaye  hain.  Total  10  logon  ki team hai. Teen toh hum — matlab main, Bhuvan aur Gauri. Future Earth se Jaayu, future Gauri, aur future Om. Demon universe se Om aur Ishaan. Nebula se Nebulian Commander. Aur Hero universe se — ek bahut special aadmi." Usne  ek  ladke  ki  taraf  ishaara  kiya  jo  peeche  khada  tha. "Iska  naam  bhi  Tanish  hai,"  Om  ne  kaha,  "but  with  superpowers.  Ye  sound  se  10X  speed  se  udd sakta hai. Iske ek punch se kayi chote moons tut sakte hain. Isliye villain Ishaan se ladne mein bahut help karega isse iske universe ke log Godcode bulate hai.” Sab  uski  taraf  hairaan  hoke  dekhne  lage.

"Humara  plan  ye  hai,"  Om  ne  aage  kaha,  awaaz  mein  gambhirta.  "Hum  OMNIGUARDS  ko  lekar uss universe mein jaayenge jisse wo mitaane wala hai. Phir usse ladke usko distract karenge. Aur samay milne par — demon universe ka Om, humne jo gun banayi hai, Astra Gun, jismein Navmani hai, usse uska bracelet tod denge." "Isse  bracelet  se  ki  hui  saari  cheezein  reverse  ho  jayengi.  Aur  uski  saari  powers  bhi  chali jayengi." Ye  plan  bataake,  Om  ek  pal  ke  liye  ruka.  Uski  nazrein  Bhuvan  par  gayi  —  jo  abhi  bhi  apni cheekh dabaye khada tha, apni beti ka wo "bye" abhi tak kaanon mein goonj raha tha. "Ye  sirf  multiverse  ko  bachaane  ka  mission  nahi  hai,"  Om  ne  kaha,  awaaz  mein  wo  shiddat  thi  jo pehle kabhi nahi thi. "Ye  humare  apno  ko  badla  lene  ka  mission  hai." "Its  Mission  —  Revenge." Chapter  4:  Universe-2604 SAHAY  ka  message  aaya  —  screen  par  ek  naya  alert  flash  hua.

"Uska  agla  target  —  Universe-2604." Tanish  ka  chehra  ek  pal  ke  liye  hairaan  ho  gaya.  "Ye  toh  mera  universe  hai." Kamre  mein  khamoshi  chha  gayi.  Om  ne  uski  taraf  dekha,  phir  sabki  taraf. "Sab  ready  ho  jao,"  Om  ne  kaha,  awaaz  seedhi,  bina  kaanpe. Portals  khole  gaye  —  purple  roshni  ke  daayre,  hawa  mein  ghoomte  hue. "OMNIGUARDS,"  Om  ne  poore  team  ki  taraf  dekhte  hue  kaha,  "are  you  ready?" Sabne  ek  saath  jawab  diya  —  "Yes." "Then  let's  go." Sab  portal  mein  kood  gaye. Doosri  taraf  pahunchte  hi  —  aasman  laal  tha.  Poora  universe  jal  raha  tha,  jaise  duniya  khud apni ashes mein badal rahi ho. Aur  saamne  —  Ishaan. Par  ye  Ishaan  nahi  tha  jo  Om  jaanta  tha.  Iski  aankhein  red  current  se  bhari  hui  thi,  poora  sharir ek dark energy se ghira hua — dekhkar hi darr lagta tha. Uske  charon  taraf  tabaahi  thi  —  buildings,  cheez,  sab  kuch  reduce  ho  chuka  tha  malbe  mein. "Tum  log  aa  gaye,"  Ishaan  ne  kaha,  awaaz  mein  ek  thandi  ghinauni  khushi.  "Bade  bahadur  ho. Mujhe laga apne universe mein darr se chhupe rahoge." Om  ne  apna  haath  uthaya.  "Attack!" Jaayu,  Future  Gauri,  Future  Om,  aur  demon  universe  wale  Ishaan  —  sabne  ek  saath  goliyan chalani shuru kar di. Ishaan  ne  bas  apna  haath  ghumaya. Ek  energy  field  nikli,  itni  tez  ki  charon  ko  door  udakar  gira  diya. "Thode  takkar  wale  laao,"  Ishaan  ne  muskurate  hue  kaha. Tabhi  Godcode  aur  Nebulian  Commander  aage  badhe. Aur  phir  shuru  hui  —  asli  ladaai.

Godcode  sound  se  dus  guna  speed  se  udta  hua  Ishaan  ki  taraf  laata,  ek  punch  maarta  jismein zameen kaanp jaati. Nebulian Commander apne laser blades nikaalta, roshni ke teekhe waar karta ek ke baad ek. Ishaan  har  waar  ko  haste  hue  jhelta  —  kabhi  apni  energy  field  se  rok  leta,  kabhi  bracelet  se banaye hue shadow clones khada kar deta jo Om aur Bhuvan se bhi lad rahe the. Bhuvan  apni  gun  se  fire  karta,  Gauri  apne  haath  ke  weapon  se  energy  blasts  chalati.  Poora aasman roshniyon se bhar gaya — laal, purple, blue, sab ek doosre se takra rahe the. Kayi  minute  tak  ladaai  chalti  rahi  —  koi  bhi  jeetne  ki  position  mein  nahi  tha. Aakhir  mein,  Ishaan  tang  aa  gaya. Usne  apna  size  badhaya  —  dheere  dheere,  poore  aasman  jitna  bada  ho  gaya.  Godcode  jo  udd raha tha, usse ek haath se pakadke seedha zameen par patak diya. Nebulian Commander ko laser se door pheink diya, uska sharir malbe mein ja gira. Isi  mauke  ko  dekhkar  —  demon  universe  ka  Om,  jo  peeche  chhupa  hua  tha,  ne  Astra  Gun uthayi. Usne  target  lock  kiya,  seedha  Ishaan  ke  bracelet  par.  Fire  kiya. Beam  gayi,  bracelet  se  takrayi  —bracelet  tut  gya  ! Par  kuch  nahi  hua. Villain  Ishaan  hasne  laga  —  zor  se,  poore  maidan  mein  goonjti  hui  hasi. "Tumhe  lagta  hai  ye  bracelet  meri  power  hai?"  usne  kaha,  aankhein  aur  laal  ho  gayi.  "Main tumhare jaisa kamzor aur bewkoof nahi hoon jo iska power istemal karna nahi jaanta hoon." "Main  amar  hoon." Kehte  kehte  wo  aage  badha,  seedha  Om  ki  taraf. Par  tabhi  beech  mein  Gauri  aa  gayi,  uske  aur  Om  ke  beech  khadi  hoke. Villain  Ishaan  ne  dekha,  phir  muskuraya  —  wo  ghinauni  muskaan. "Tumhe  kya  lagta  hai,main  ek  ko  hi  maarunga?" Usne  apna  haath  upar  kiya. Aur  sab  —  Om,  Gauri,  Bhuvan,  poori  team  —  hawa  mein  udd  gaye,  jaise  unke  sharir  par  kisi invisible force ne pakad liya ho. Uske  chehre  par  muskaan  aur  gehri  ho  gayi,  jaise  final  moment  aa  gaya  ho.

Aur  tabhi  — Achanak  aasman  purple  hone  laga.  Poore  maidan  mein  ek  naya  rang  phailne  laga,  jaise  kisi  ne pardah khainch diya ho. Peeche  se  ek  awaaz  aayi  —  bhaari,  shaant,  par  itni  powerful  ki  poore  aasman  mein  goonj  gayi. "Unhe  chhod  de." Villain  Ishaan  ne  peeche  mudkar  dekha. Aur  wahan  aasman  mein  khada  tha  — OG.  The  God  Ishaan. Chapter  5:  Destiny Villain  Ishaan  uddta  hua  seedha  space  mein  pahuncha,  Ishaan  ke  paas,  aur  ek  jhatke  mein apna size uske barabar kar liya. Dono  ab  aasman  mein  aamne-saamne  khade  the,  stars  ke  beech,  poore  multiverse  ki  dhadkan jaise ruk gayi ho.

"Jab  lagta  hai  final  countdown  aa  gaya,"  Ishaan  ne  kaha,  awaaz  shaant  thi,  "tab  kuch  na  kuch naya aa jaata hai. Iss baar final hona chahiye." Villain  Ishaan  ne  muskurate  hue  kaha,  "Main  bhi  yahi  chahta  hoon." "Yeh  last  turn  hai,"  Ishaan  ne  kaha.  "Sab  theek  kar  de.  Maaf  kar  dunga." Villain  Ishaan  ki  aankhon  mein  gussa  bhad-ka.  "Kyun?  Kyun  kiye  tune  itne  sacrifice?" "Chal  tune  kiye  toh  kiye,"  usne  kaha,  "zaroori  hai  saare  Ishaan  karein?" Ishaan  ne  ek  pal  socha.  "Agar  Ishaan  ne  apna  nature  hi  badal  liya,  toh  Ishaan  thodi  rahega. Isliye toh saare Ishaan — Ishaan ke naam se jaane jaate hain. Aur tu — villain Ishaan ke naam se." Villain  Ishaan  hasa,  kadwahat  bhari.  "Matlab  jo  apne  baare  mein  soche  wo  villain?" "Apne  baare  mein  sochna  bura  nahi,"  Ishaan  ne  kaha,  "lekin  apne  liye  kisi  aur  ko  chot pahunchana bura hai." "Toh  main  bura  hi  sahi,"  villain  Ishaan  ne  kaha. "Jaisi  tumhari  marzi." Aur  phir  shuru  hui  —  do  sabse  powerful  insaano  ki  jung. Ek  waar  itna  tez  ki  hawa  fatt  gayi.  Dono  ek  doosre  par  toot  gaye,  mukke,  energy  blasts, dhamake jo poori galaxy mein goonjte the. Kabhi Ishaan peeche hatta, kabhi villain Ishaan. Ek pal ek dusre ko planets se marte, dusre pal khud ko sambhalte, phir se udkar tootne wapas aate. Ye  fight  kareeb  ek  mahina  chalti  rahi  —  na  koi  ruka,  na  koi  haara.  Har  din  poore  universes  mein iski gunj sunayi deti — asteroids todte hue, stars ki roshni ko cut karte hue, dono ek doosre ke barabar, ek doosre se zyada. Aakhir  mein  —  villain  Ishaan  ne  ek  final  punch  maara. Itna  zabardast  ki  Ishaan  seedha,  control  kho  kar,  Earth  pe  jaake  gira.  Zameen  mein  ek  gehra crater ban gaya, dhool aasman tak uthi. Villain  Ishaan  neeche  charge  hota  hai  —  poori  speed  se,  seedha  Ishaan  ki  taraf. Ishaan  zameen  se  uthta  hai.  Apne  haath  mein  Navmani  leta  hai  —  chamakti  hui,  tayyar. Aur  villain  Ishaan  ki  taraf  badhta  hai. Ek  pal  ka  takraav.

Aur  phir  —  villain  Ishaan  evaporate  ho  jaata  hai.  Hawa  mein  bikhar  jaata  hai,  jaise  kabhi  tha  hi nahi. Ishaan  ek  gehri  saans  leta  hai.  Phir  Navmani  ko  apne  haath  mein  liye,  singularity  sphere  ke center mein rakhta hai. Ek  roshni  ki  lehar  poore  multiverse  mein  failti  hai  — Aur  saare  universes  reload  hone  lagte  hain.  Dheere  dheere,  apni  original  form  mein  wapas  aate hue, jaise kisi ne poori kitaab wapas sahi page pe khol di ho. Ishaan  sabko  jaane  ko  kehta  hai.  Phir  khud  singularity  sphere  ke  center  mein  baith  jaata  hai,  ek thakaan bhari lekin sukoon bhari shaant mudra mein. Uske  peeche  Bhuvan  aata  hai.  Uske  bagal  mein  baith  jaata  hai. "Itni  der  kyun  laga  di  aane  mein?"  Bhuvan  ne  poochha,  awaaz  mein  halka  sa  dukh. "Main  toh  hamesha  saath  tha,"  Ishaan  ne  kaha.  "Aapko  kya  lagta  hai  —  wo  humare  universe  ko kyun nahi mitaa paa raha tha? Jo hua wo hona zaroori tha. That was destiny." Bhuvan  ne  apni  pocket  se  locket  nikaala  —  wahi  jo  Mikhail  ka  tha,  ab  khaali.  Ek  sarcastic  si muskaan ke saath usne kaha, "Destiny." Ishaan  ne  apni  pocket  se  Avika  ka  bracelet  nikaala,  jo  usne  kabhi  sambhal  ke  rakha  tha.  "Haan destiny." Dono  ne  ek  doosre  ko  dekha.  Kuch  keh  nahi  paaye. Phir  gale  mile  —  kaskar,  jaise  saalon  ki  thakaan,  saara  dard,  sab  ek  pal  mein  bahar  nikal  raha ho. Saare  log  apne  apne  universe  wapas  gaye  —  Jaayu,  Godcode,  Nebulian  Commander,  sab,  ek ek karke portals se guzarte hue, apni apni duniya mein. Ishaan  ne  kaha,  "Mere  paas  itni  powers  aa  gayi  hain  ki  main  ab  aap  logon  ke  saath  nahi  reh paunga. Bahut khatra hai. Par main hamesha aapke saath rahunga." Aur  itna  kehke  —  usne  unn  sabko  main  universe  mein  teleport  kar  diya. Om,  Bhuvan,  Gauri,  sab  seedha  Kenji  ke  paas  pahunche. Kenji  bistar  par  thae,  kamzor,  par  aankhon  mein  sukoon  tha. Kenji  ne  Om  ko  bulaya,  uska  haath  apne  haath  mein  liya.

"Tumne  apna  wada  poora  kiya,"  usne  dheeme  se  kaha.  "Mera  ashirwaad  hamesha  rahega tumhare saath." Itna  kehke  —  unka  haath  dheela  pad  gaya.  Unki  saansein  ruk  gayi. Kamra  khamosh  ho  gaya.  Sirf  Gauri  ki  dabi  hui  sisakiyan,  Om  ka  sar  jhuka  hua,  Bhuvan  ki aankhon mein aansu. Kenji  ki  aatma  dheere  se  uthti  hai,  roshni  mein  badalti  hui,  upar  ki  taraf  —  heaven  mein. Wahan  wo  milte  hain  —  Anjali,  Avika,  aur  Mikhail.  Sab  muskurate  hue,  ek  doosre  ko  dekhte hue, jaise saalon baad koi ghar wapas aaya ho. Waqt  aage  badhta  hai. Om  aur  Gauri  ka  ek  beta  hota  hai.  Uska  naam  rakha  jaata  hai  —  Vinayak. Chhoti  Avika  bhi  dheere  dheere  samajh  jaati  hai  ki  Mikhail  sach  mein  kabhi  wapas  nahi  aayegi — par uski yaadein hamesha uske saath rahengi, uss painting ki tarah jo Bhuvan ki jacket mein hamesha rehti hai. Bhuvan  ISRO  wapas  join  kar  leta  hai  —  apne  kaam  mein  wapas,  apni  zindagi  mein  wapas,  par ab ek nayi samajh ke saath. Aur  kahin,  kisi  aasman  mein,  poore  multiverse  ki  nigraani  karta  —  Ishaan.  Akela,  par  sabke kareeb. Hamesha.
